natural: Promotion in office and rank

meaning.en: To be promoted and ennobled; to rise in rank.
meaning.zh: 官职提升，爵位晋级。

examples.zh: 他立了大功，被加官进爵。
examples.en: For his great service he was promoted and ennobled.

examples.zh: 祝您加官进爵，步步高升！
examples.en: Wishing you promotion after promotion!

usage.zh: 多作谓语，也用作祝福语。

natural: Nibbling like silkworms, swallowing like whales

meaning.en: To annex territory bit by bit or all at once.
meaning.zh: 像蚕吃桑叶那样一步步侵占，像鲸吞食那样一下子吞并。比喻各种侵吞方式。

examples.zh: 列强对中国蚕食鲸吞。
examples.en: The foreign powers nibbled away at and swallowed up Chinese territory.

examples.zh: 大公司蚕食鲸吞了许多小企业。
examples.en: Big companies have swallowed up many small firms.

natural: A slave's face and a servant's knees

meaning.en: Servile and obsequious.
meaning.zh: 形容卑躬屈膝、谄媚讨好的样子。

examples.zh: 他对上司奴颜婢膝，对下属却很凶。
examples.en: He grovels to his superiors but bullies his subordinates.

examples.zh: 做人要有骨气，不能奴颜婢膝。
examples.en: Have some backbone — don't be servile.

natural: Loaded by the cart and measured by the bushel

meaning.en: Very common; a dime a dozen.
meaning.zh: 用车装，用斗量。形容数量很多，不足为奇。

examples.zh: 这样的人才车载斗量。
examples.en: People like that are ten a penny.

examples.zh: 这类产品市场上车载斗量。
examples.en: Products like this are a dime a dozen.

origin.source: 《三国志·吴书·吴主传》裴松之注

story.en: The Wu envoy Zhao Zi, asked by Cao Pi how many men of his calibre Wu had, replied: "Men like me can be counted by the cartload and measured by the bushel."
story.zh: 吴国使者赵咨对曹丕说："聪明特达者八九十人，如臣之比，车载斗量，不可胜数。"

natural: Body and shadow consoling each other

meaning.en: Utterly alone.
meaning.zh: 只有自己的身体和影子互相慰问。形容孤单无依。

examples.zh: 他晚年形影相吊，非常孤独。
examples.en: In old age he was utterly alone.

examples.zh: 茕茕孑立，形影相吊。
examples.en: Alone and isolated, with only my shadow for company.

story.en: Li Mi described his childhood: "Alone and without support, body and shadow consoling each other" (茕茕孑立，形影相吊).
story.zh: 李密《陈情表》："茕茕孑立，形影相吊。"

natural: Enough whips thrown in to dam the river

meaning.en: An enormous army (often with overconfidence).
meaning.zh: 把所有的马鞭投到江里，就能截断水流。比喻人马众多，兵力强大。

examples.zh: 苻坚自以为投鞭断流，结果在淝水大败。
examples.en: Fu Jian boasted of his vast army but was crushed at the Fei River.

examples.zh: 敌军号称投鞭断流，其实不堪一击。
examples.en: The enemy boasted overwhelming numbers but collapsed at the first blow.

story.en: Before attacking Jin, Fu Jian boasted: "With my host, if we threw our whips into the Yangtze, they would dam its flow" (足断其流). He was routed at Fei River.
story.zh: 苻坚说："以吾之众旅，投鞭于江，足断其流。"后在淝水之战中大败。

usage.zh: 多作谓语，常含骄傲轻敌之意。

natural: Circling the rafters for three days

meaning.en: (Of music) so beautiful it lingers for days.
meaning.zh: 形容歌声优美，余音长久不绝。

examples.zh: 她的歌声绕梁三日，令人难忘。
examples.en: Her singing lingers in the memory for days.

examples.zh: 这场音乐会真是绕梁三日。
examples.en: The concert was truly haunting.

story.en: After the singer Han E left Qi, her lingering notes circled the rafters and did not stop for three days.
story.zh: 韩娥过齐国卖唱，离开后"余音绕梁欐，三日不绝"。

usage.en: Predicate. Close to 余音绕梁.

natural: A whole body made of courage

meaning.en: Fearless; courageous through and through.
meaning.zh: 形容胆量极大，无所畏惧。

examples.zh: 这位消防员浑身是胆。
examples.en: The firefighter is utterly fearless.

examples.zh: 赵子龙浑身是胆，单骑救主。
examples.en: Fearless Zhao Yun rode alone to rescue his lord's son.

origin.source: 《三国志·蜀书·赵云传》裴松之注

story.en: After Zhao Yun's daring defence of a camp against Cao Cao's army, Liu Bei said: "Zilong's whole body is courage!" (子龙一身都是胆也).
story.zh: 赵云坚守营寨击退曹军，刘备赞叹："子龙一身都是胆也。"

natural: A blade of grass and the spring sunshine

meaning.en: A mother's love is too great for a child ever to repay.
meaning.zh: 小草微薄的心意报答不了春日阳光的深情。比喻父母的恩情难以报答。

equivalents: a mother's love can never be repaid

examples.zh: 寸草春晖，父母的恩情永远报答不完。
examples.en: A blade of grass can never repay the spring sun — we can never repay our parents.

examples.zh: 母亲节，他写下"寸草春晖"表达感恩。
examples.en: On Mother's Day he wrote "grass and spring sunshine" to express his gratitude.

story.en: Meng Jiao's famous poem of a mother sewing her son's clothes ends: "Who can say the heart of an inch of grass could ever repay the sunshine of three spring months?"
story.zh: 孟郊《游子吟》："谁言寸草心，报得三春晖。"

natural: Clouds vanishing and fog dispersing

meaning.en: Doubts or troubles vanish completely.
meaning.zh: 云雾消散。比喻疑虑、怨恨、误会等彻底消除。

examples.zh: 误会解开后，两人之间的隔阂云消雾散。
examples.en: Once the misunderstanding was cleared up, the rift between them vanished.

examples.zh: 太阳出来，雾霾云消雾散。
examples.en: When the sun came out, the smog cleared.

natural: If you don't enter the tiger's den…

meaning.en: Nothing ventured, nothing gained.
meaning.zh: 不进老虎洞，怎能捉到小老虎。比喻不冒险就不能获得成功。

examples.zh: 不入虎穴，焉得虎子？我们要敢于冒险。
examples.en: Nothing ventured, nothing gained — we must dare to take risks.

examples.zh: 记者深入调查，不入虎穴，焉得虎子。
examples.en: The reporter went undercover — who dares wins.

story.en: Ban Chao, on a mission to Shanshan with 36 men, learned a Xiongnu envoy had arrived. He said: "If you don't enter the tiger's den, how will you catch the cub?" — and attacked the Xiongnu camp at night.
story.zh: 班超出使鄯善，得知匈奴使者到来，说："不入虎穴，不得虎子。"率众夜袭匈奴营地。

natural: Watching for the moment and then acting

meaning.en: To watch for the right moment and act accordingly.
meaning.zh: 观察时机，然后行动。

examples.zh: 我们先观察形势，相机而动。
examples.en: We'll watch the situation and act when the moment is right.

examples.zh: 投资要相机而动，不能盲目。
examples.en: Wait for the right moment to invest — don't act blindly.

natural: Raising a tiger and leaving future trouble

meaning.en: To spare an enemy and store up trouble.
meaning.zh: 留着老虎不除掉，就会留下祸患。比喻纵容敌人，留下后患。

equivalents: nurse a viper in one's bosom

examples.zh: 放过他就是养虎遗患。
examples.en: Letting him go is storing up trouble.

examples.zh: 对腐败不能心慈手软，以免养虎遗患。
examples.en: Don't go easy on corruption, or you'll pay for it later.

story.en: Zhang Liang and Chen Ping urged Liu Bang to pursue Xiang Yu rather than make peace: "To let him go now would be raising a tiger and leaving trouble for yourself."
story.zh: 张良、陈平劝刘邦："今释弗击，此所谓养虎自遗患也。"

natural: A sound that stops the drifting clouds

meaning.en: (Of singing) loud and soaring.
meaning.zh: 声音高入云霄，把浮动着的云彩也止住了。形容歌声嘹亮。

examples.zh: 她的歌声响遏行云。
examples.en: Her singing soared to the heavens.

examples.zh: 合唱团的歌声响遏行云，震撼人心。
examples.en: The choir raised the roof and stirred every heart.

story.en: The singing teacher Qin Qing, bidding farewell to a student who thought he'd learned enough, sang a song that "shook the forest trees and stopped the drifting clouds". The student stayed.
story.zh: 秦青为薛谭饯行，"抚节悲歌，声振林木，响遏行云"。薛谭于是留下继续学习。

natural: Seeking the root and asking for the bottom

meaning.en: To get to the bottom of things.
meaning.zh: 追究底细，弄清来龙去脉。

examples.zh: 孩子对什么都喜欢寻根问底。
examples.en: Children love getting to the bottom of everything.

examples.zh: 记者寻根问底，揭开了真相。
examples.en: The reporter dug deeper and uncovered the truth.

natural: Fierce fire reveals true gold

meaning.en: Adversity reveals true character.
meaning.zh: 比喻在严峻的考验中才能看出人的真正品质。

equivalents: a friend in need is a friend indeed

examples.zh: 烈火见真金，危难时刻方显英雄本色。
examples.en: Adversity reveals character — heroes show themselves in crisis.

examples.zh: 困难面前，烈火见真金。
examples.en: In hard times, true mettle shows.

natural: The phoenixes fly together

meaning.en: A happy marriage (wedding blessing).
meaning.zh: 凤和凰相偕而飞。比喻夫妻和好恩爱。常用以祝人婚姻美满。

examples.zh: 祝新人凤凰于飞，百年好合。
examples.en: May the newlyweds fly together like phoenixes, happily married for a hundred years.

examples.zh: 婚礼上挂着"凤凰于飞"的横幅。
examples.en: A banner at the wedding read "Phoenixes flying together".

story.en: The Book of Songs: "The phoenixes fly, rustling their wings" (凤凰于飞，翙翙其羽) — the male feng and female huang flying side by side.
story.zh: 《诗经·卷阿》："凤凰于飞，翙翙其羽。"

natural: A sack for wine and a bag for rice

meaning.en: A good-for-nothing who only eats and drinks.
meaning.zh: 装酒装饭的口袋。讥讽无能的人，只会吃喝，不会做事。

examples.zh: 他是个酒囊饭袋，什么事也干不成。
examples.en: He's a good-for-nothing who can't get anything done.

examples.zh: 养着一群酒囊饭袋，公司怎么会好？
examples.en: How can a company thrive supporting a bunch of freeloaders?

natural: Killing the chicken to warn the monkey

meaning.en: To punish one as a warning to others.
meaning.zh: 比喻惩罚一个人来警告其他的人。

examples.zh: 公司开除了一个迟到最多的人，杀鸡儆猴。
examples.en: The company fired the worst latecomer to make an example of him.

examples.zh: 这次严惩是杀鸡儆猴。
examples.en: This harsh punishment is a warning to others.

usage.en: Predicate. Also 杀鸡骇猴 / 杀鸡给猴看. 儆 is jǐng.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。也作"杀鸡骇猴""杀鸡给猴看"。

natural: Stammering and stuttering

meaning.en: Stammering; halting in speech.
meaning.zh: 形容口吃，说话不流利。

examples.zh: 他紧张得期期艾艾，说不出话来。
examples.en: He was so nervous he stammered and couldn't get the words out.

examples.zh: 面对质问，她期期艾艾地解释着。
examples.en: Faced with questions, she explained haltingly.

origin.source: 《史记·张丞相列传》；《世说新语·言语》

story.en: Two famous stammerers: the Han minister Zhou Chang said "I q-q-know it's wrong" (期期知其不可); the Wei general Deng Ai referred to himself as "Ai-Ai". Their stammers combined into the idiom.
story.zh: 汉代周昌口吃，说"臣期期知其不可"；三国邓艾口吃，自称"艾艾"。后合为"期期艾艾"。

natural: Defying superiors and stirring up chaos

meaning.en: To defy authority and rebel.
meaning.zh: 冒犯尊长或上级，进行叛乱。

examples.zh: 在古代，犯上作乱是重罪。
examples.en: In ancient times, rebelling against authority was a grave crime.

examples.zh: 这些人犯上作乱，被朝廷镇压了。
examples.en: These rebels were suppressed by the court.

story.en: Youzi: "Few who are filial and respectful to elders like to offend their superiors; none who dislike offending superiors like to make rebellion."
story.zh: 《论语·学而》："其为人也孝弟，而好犯上者，鲜矣；不好犯上，而好作乱者，未之有也。"

natural: A rope sawing through wood

meaning.en: Persistence achieves the seemingly impossible.
meaning.zh: 用绳子当锯子也能把木头锯断。比喻力量虽小，只要坚持不懈，事情就能成功。

equivalents: slow and steady wins the race
constant dripping wears away the stone

examples.zh: 绳锯木断，水滴石穿。
examples.en: A rope saws through wood; dripping water pierces stone.

examples.zh: 学习要有绳锯木断的毅力。
examples.en: Learning needs the persistence of a rope sawing through wood.

story.en: Magistrate Zhang Guaiya sentenced a clerk who stole one coin a day: "A rope saws through wood; dripping water pierces stone."
story.zh: 张乖崖判案："一日一钱，千日千钱，绳锯木断，水滴石穿。"

natural: As many as the sands of the Ganges

meaning.en: Countless; as numerous as grains of sand.
meaning.zh: 像恒河里的沙子那样多。形容数量极多。

examples.zh: 宇宙中的星星多如恒河沙数。
examples.en: The stars in the universe are as countless as grains of sand.

examples.zh: 历史上的无名英雄恒河沙数。
examples.en: History's unsung heroes are innumerable.

story.en: The Diamond Sutra repeatedly uses "as many as the sands of the Ganges" (恒河沙数) to express immeasurable numbers.
story.zh: 《金刚经》："如恒河中所有沙数，如是沙等恒河。"

usage.zh: 多作谓语、宾语。源自佛经。

natural: A rare talent unmatched in the age

meaning.en: A genius unmatched in one's era.
meaning.zh: 当代没有人能相比的奇特人才。

examples.zh: 达·芬奇是一位旷世奇才。
examples.en: Da Vinci was a once-in-a-generation genius.

examples.zh: 苏轼被誉为旷世奇才。
examples.en: Su Shi is hailed as a genius unmatched in his age.
